_comment: SEEDED FILE — copied here once by the AI-Handbook sync, then owned by this repo.
Unlike the synced contract files, this one is yours to edit: permission allowlists
and env legitimately differ per product, and a sync that overwrote them would clobber
grants the repo needs. Delete this _comment block once the file is adapted.
Adapt before use:
env.DATABASE_URL   — the repo's own test database URL, or drop the key entirely
until the repo has a database.
hooks.SessionStart — points at scripts/setup-test-db.sh. Drop this hook until that
script exists, or the first session of every day opens with a
failing hook.
permissions.deny   — the drizzle-kit entries assume Drizzle. Keep the shape (deny the
command that can push schema straight at a live database) and
swap the tool. Read(**/.env*) applies to every repo — keep it.
permissions.allow  — the MCP server id in the first block is per-environment and will
differ here. The three spellings of the remote server are all
listed on purpose: the id varies by how the session was started,
and a missing spelling shows up as a permission prompt that stalls
an autonomous session.
The guard hooks are NOT optional. They are the local half of the branch-protection
story and the reason a force push needs an explicit refspec. Keep all three PreToolUse
entries, including the longer timeout on the merge matcher — the merge guard reads live
GitHub state and 5s is not enough for it.
